previous_statement: The datum's one-dimensional delta-projection Q is nonvanishing: one-dimensional means its compressed corner has dimension one, whereas the vanishing alternative is the zero corner; thus the nonvanishing clause of lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm applies to Q.
new_statement: The current allowed inputs do not imply that the datum's one-dimensional delta-projection Q is nonvanishing: def-hcb-datum assumes the qualifier 'one-dimensional', but neither it nor def-column-hilbert-corner defines that qualifier or relates it to the vanishing/nonvanishing dichotomy. Consequently the nonvanishing clause of lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm cannot be applied until the missing one-dimensional-delta-projection definition (or an allowed lemma proving this implication) is provisioned.
